config.notes: University of Waikato qualification pages (www.waikato.ac.nz/study/qualifications/... and /int/study/qualifications/...). Plain HTML, no page data. Each page has a summary line near the top: '<points>, <duration> <campus> <school> <start trimesters with months> Domestic: $X per year, International: $Y per year'; some pages print the labels (Points and Duration, Locations, Start Dates, Estimated fees). Intakes = start trimesters with months in brackets (e.g. 'Trimester A (March) and Trimester B (July)'). Fee = the 'International: $Y per year' figure, or the 'International: $Y (120 pts)' figure on masters pages that price 120 and 180/240 points separately (Waikato prints 120 points as one academic year of full-time study, e.g. MDigiBus '120 points, 1 academic year (full-time study over A and B trimesters)'); ranges ('$34,062 - $44,342 per year'), bare figures with no basis, 180/240-point totals and Foundation accelerated/standard splits are not read. No year is printed with the international figure. IELTS is not on course pages: central rule at https://www.waikato.ac.nz/int/about/calendar/admission/english-language-requirements/ (UG 6.0 no band below 5.5; PG 6.5 no band below 6.0; LLB 6.5/6.0; BNurs 6.5/6.5; ITE 7.0/7.0; MPSOCS, MClinPrac(Midwifery), MNursPrac, MPharmPrac 7.0/7.0). Teaching periods: https://www.waikato.ac.nz/about/calendar/important-dates/teaching-and-assessment-periods/ (Trimester A starts March, B July, C/G November, H January); term_months not set because some pages print February for Trimester A. Mode (delivery) is read only when the location list in the summary is exactly "Online" (online only). Pages list delivery as places (Hamilton, Tauranga, Online) with no campus wording, and the delivery normaliser does not treat town names as on campus, so campus-only and mixed lists (e.g. "Hamilton, Online") give no mode rather than a wrong "online". International view (5 Oct 13:02): the /int/study/qualifications/<slug>/ pages are the international student view (site set to English (International)); courses are bound to them. A plain fetch already carries the summary line with the international fee and start trimesters, and a rendered read (tested on 10 pages) adds nothing more: no fee year is printed for the international figure and IELTS is not on course pages, so page_view rendering is off. Catalogue titles are compared without the (Level N) suffix (course_title_strip). Entry requirement (5 Oct 15:22): not read. The stored /int/ qualification pages print the Entry requirements tabs (Domestic students / International students) but only the domestic tab content is in the stored page (e.g. "There are five ways you can gain admission..."), so no international entry requirement can be read; patterns.entry_requirement is not set. Exit awards and whole-course fees: no "after N years of full-time study you can exit with" wording and no international whole-course fee found in stored pages.
